scientific limitations/integrity: The claim disproves only the product uniqueness clause of the proposed diameter equality theorem, not the universal diameter inequality. The canonical Plücker trace metric is scaled by 2N and the Ricci normalization is computed from the local Kähler potential. The diameter formula relies on the proved intrinsic Grassmann principal-angle distance, not the smaller ambient Plücker projective angle. The topological obstruction uses second Betti numbers. The independent audit has not been performed.
title: Balanced Grassmannians defeat the proposed Kähler diameter equality rigidity
